meta.catalogueUpdate: Public catalogue limited to the 15 selected products.

products.name: LoopPilot
products.desc: LoopPilot is a professional Windows engineering platform for loop readiness, instrument validation and PID advisory. It reviews PV, SP and MV behaviour, checks data quality and loop health, and helps engineers distinguish tuning problems from instrument, valve, actuator and process limitations. It includes plant-style Instrument HMI review, evidence and reporting in a read-only advisory workflow. One professional workstation licence. Evaluation and Plant Edition available. No automatic PLC or DCS writes.
products.shortDescription: Professional loop-readiness, instrument-validation and PID-advisory software for safer, evidence-based control-loop improvement.

products.name: VisionEdge
products.desc: Available now: Camera setup, ROI analysis, edge and object detection, static measurement, inspection evidence, reporting, diagnostics, and controlled API/OPC UA integration. In development: High-speed plate-width measurement, defect classification, block measurement, steering-roll and strip-break monitoring, and general number-plate reading. Planned: Camera-health checks, confidence scoring, image rejection, calibration verification, production history, FAT/SAT, and commissioning tools.
products.shortDescription: Available now: Camera setup, ROI analysis, edge and object detection, static measurement, inspection evidence, reporting, diagnostics, and controlled API/OPC UA integration.

products.name: PROFIBUS Connector: GSD Engineering Studio
products.desc: PROFIBUS Connector: GSD Engineering Studio provides a structured workspace for PROFIBUS network design, GSD definition management, master and field-device configuration, process-data mapping, engineering review and commissioning documentation. It is intended for controlled engineering work and does not claim physical signal-quality or cable diagnostics without compatible external hardware. Professional workstation licence. Diagnostic interfaces and field hardware are excluded.
products.shortDescription: Professional GSD and PROFIBUS engineering workspace for network design, device definitions, process data review and commissioning documentation.

products.name: Universal Modbus Device Engineering Platform
products.desc: The Universal Modbus Device Engineering Platform combines Modbus RTU and TCP discovery, polling, slave simulation, register-map engineering, data-format decoding, logging, device profiles and commissioning evidence in one professional workspace. It is designed for device integration and repeatable engineering rather than basic polling alone. One professional workstation licence with a 30-day evaluation. Team and site licensing are available separately.
products.shortDescription: Professional Modbus RTU/TCP engineering platform for discovery, decoding, simulation, register mapping, testing and commissioning evidence.

products.name: WA Hybrid Alarm
products.desc: WA Hybrid Alarm is the software and firmware platform for secure local alarm operation, GSM and Wi-Fi configuration, sensor and zone management, event visibility, diagnostics and field-ready security workflows. The listed price is for the software licence and production package. ESP32, GSM module, sensors, enclosure, power hardware, installation and commissioning are excluded. A configured complete system is available from R6,995.
products.shortDescription: Hybrid alarm management software for secure local operation, GSM and Wi-Fi configuration, event visibility and field-ready alarm workflows.

products.name: WA 3D Printer Production GUI
products.desc: Production-focused interface for practical 3D-printer operation, machine setup, job control and workshop monitoring.
products.shortDescription: Production-focused interface for practical 3D-printer operation, machine setup, job control and workshop monitoring.
products.archivedReason: Not included in the current public catalogue.

products.name: Battery Charger Control Studio
products.desc: Battery Charger Control Studio provides a focused engineering workspace for charger configuration, battery monitoring, diagnostics, controlled tests and documented validation. The listed price covers the Windows software package. Controller boards, charger power electronics, battery hardware, wiring and commissioning are excluded.
products.shortDescription: Battery-charger control and test workspace for configuration, monitoring, diagnostics and documented workshop validation.

products.name: Device Engineering Studio
products.desc: Device Engineering Studio is a capability-aware engineering environment for verified board profiles, safe I/O selection, reserved and boot-sensitive pin protection, firmware compatibility, signal assignment, board overview and device commissioning. It is built to prevent unsupported devices, sensors and functions from being presented as buildable. One professional workstation licence. Physical boards, modules and custom integration are excluded.
products.shortDescription: Capability-aware board and I/O engineering studio for verified device profiles, safe signal assignment, firmware alignment and commissioning.

products.name: Wykies DriveBench ECU+TCU Suite
products.desc: Integrated ECU and TCU test-bench suite for serial diagnostics, configuration and controlled vehicle-system development.
products.shortDescription: Integrated ECU and TCU test-bench suite for serial diagnostics, configuration and controlled vehicle-system development.
products.archivedReason: Not included in the current public catalogue.

products.name: Cold Storage Monitoring System
products.desc: Cold Storage Monitoring System provides temperature monitoring, alarm handling, event history, equipment visibility and operational evidence for cold rooms and freezer applications. Pricing starts at the base monitoring software and configuration level. Sensors, gateways, communication hardware, enclosure, installation, calibration and commissioning are quoted according to the site and number of monitored points.
products.shortDescription: Cold-storage monitoring solution for temperature, alarms, event history, equipment visibility and operational evidence.

products.name: WA Gate Controller
products.desc: WA Gate Controller provides the software, ESP32 firmware and local HMI workflow for secure gate operation, configurable limit inputs, simulation-safe testing, diagnostics and optional MQTT communication. The listed price covers the software and production firmware package. Controller board, motor interface, GSM or Wi-Fi hardware, enclosure, power supply, wiring, installation and commissioning are excluded. Configured systems are available from R5,995.
products.shortDescription: Gate-controller software and firmware for secure local operation, configurable inputs, diagnostics, MQTT communication and field deployment.

products.name: Hardware Bench
products.desc: Hardware Bench is a professional engineering workspace for structured board and module testing, I/O validation, device setup, diagnostics, test records and technical evidence. It supports repeatable workshop and commissioning workflows without implying capabilities that the selected hardware cannot provide. The listed price is for one workstation licence. Test instruments, boards, modules and fixtures are excluded.
products.shortDescription: Engineering bench workspace for structured hardware testing, I/O validation, device setup, diagnostics and technical evidence.

products.name: HMI & SCADA Studio
products.desc: HMI & SCADA Studio supports structured HMI and SCADA engineering with reusable objects, tag structures, alarms, trends, navigation, engineering checks and deployment documentation. It is positioned as an engineering and generation studio rather than a replacement for every vendor runtime. One professional workstation licence. Vendor runtime licences, PLC or DCS software, servers, drivers and site commissioning are excluded.
products.shortDescription: Engineering studio for HMI and SCADA design, reusable objects, tag structures, alarms, trends and deployment-ready documentation.

products.name: WA Nano GSM Gate & Garage Remote
products.desc: WA Nano GSM Gate & Garage Remote provides the software and firmware package for authorised-number GSM control, secure configuration, event handling, optional open and close limit switches, box-tamper monitoring and practical gate or garage deployment. The listed price excludes the Arduino Nano, GSM module, relay or interface hardware, enclosure, SIM, antenna, power supply, wiring and installation. Configured units are available from R3,995.
products.shortDescription: GSM gate and garage remote software and firmware with authorised-number control, optional limits, event handling and secure setup.

products.name: OT Asset Assurance
products.desc: OT Asset Assurance is a governance and assurance platform for authoritative asset records, engineering evidence, configuration oversight, audit readiness, change tracking, lifecycle follow-through and executive reporting. It is designed to close practical OT governance gaps without claiming to replace full enterprise OT security suites. The listed price covers a professional single-site software licence. Discovery integrations, migration, custom connectors, onboarding and multi-site deployment are quoted separately.
products.shortDescription: OT governance and assurance platform for asset evidence, configuration control, audit readiness, change tracking and executive reporting.

products.name: OT Scanner
products.desc: OT Scanner is a controlled discovery and network-review utility for device visibility, inventory support, technical investigation and exportable evidence. It is intended for authorised engineering and audit use on approved networks. It does not replace a continuous passive OT monitoring appliance or enterprise vulnerability-management platform. One professional workstation licence. Site packs and integration are available separately.
products.shortDescription: Controlled OT and network discovery utility for device visibility, inventory support, review and exportable technical evidence.

products.name: Plasma Cutter Control Studio
products.desc: Practical control and monitoring interface for plasma-cutter setup, job workflows and workshop operation.
products.shortDescription: Practical control and monitoring interface for plasma-cutter setup, job workflows and workshop operation.

products.name: ProcessScope Studio
products.desc: ProcessScope Studio provides a structured workspace for process and instrumentation investigations, signal review, operating-pattern analysis, engineering evidence and technical reporting. It helps engineers organise datasets, examine process behaviour and document findings in a repeatable workflow. One professional workstation licence. Plant connectivity, custom data adapters, field testing and commissioning services are excluded.
products.shortDescription: Process and instrumentation analysis workspace for structured investigations, signal review, engineering evidence and reporting.

products.name: Rockwell Build Studio
products.desc: Rockwell Build Studio is a capability-aware engineering platform for controller and revision-aligned blocks, I/O structures, AOIs, UDTs, HMI objects and buildable deliverables. Unsupported items are filtered according to the selected platform and software revision. The listed price covers one professional engineering workstation. Rockwell software licences, controller hardware, site integration, validation and commissioning are excluded.
products.shortDescription: Capability-aware Rockwell engineering studio for controller-aligned blocks, I/O structures, AOIs, UDTs and buildable deliverables.

products.name: Security Guard
products.desc: Operational security-monitoring platform with event visibility, routine checks and controlled response workflows.
products.shortDescription: Operational security-monitoring platform with event visibility, routine checks and controlled response workflows.
products.archivedReason: Not included in the current public catalogue.

products.name: SEMS
products.desc: SEMS is a Solar Energy Management System for organising solar assets, equipment records, performance visibility, technical work, maintenance workflows, evidence and operational follow-through. It supports structured engineering management and reporting for practical solar installations. The listed price covers one professional workstation licence. Meters, gateways, inverters, sensors, communications, installation and custom integration are excluded.
products.shortDescription: Solar Energy Management System for equipment records, performance visibility, maintenance workflows, evidence and operational follow-through.

products.name: Sign Tool
products.desc: Focused sign-design and production utility for practical layouts, job details and workshop-ready outputs.
products.shortDescription: Focused sign-design and production utility for practical layouts, job details and workshop-ready outputs.

products.name: TCU Gearbox Studio
products.desc: Transmission-control engineering interface for gearbox diagnostics, TCU testing and controlled configuration.
products.shortDescription: Transmission-control engineering interface for gearbox diagnostics, TCU testing and controlled configuration.

products.name: VM Deployment & Recovery Command Center
products.desc: VM Deployment & Recovery Command Center provides a structured workflow for VM build, inventory, backup, restore, recovery verification, OEM preparation and disaster-recovery readiness. It supports practical operational control and evidence without positioning itself as a vCenter replacement. The listed price covers one professional workstation licence. Hypervisor, operating-system, backup-storage and third-party software licences are excluded.
products.shortDescription: VM deployment and recovery command center for build, inventory, backup, restore, verification and disaster-recovery readiness.
